description: PCB v1.1, bare board (gerber). Legacy DIY option: you must solder the resistors, capacitors, MOSFET, headers and screw terminals yourself. Use it only if you already have the old components or want to build the old board exactly. The remaining external parts are listed in the electronics BOM above. With PCB v1.1, use 12 V only for the power supply and the hotend.
Wemos D1 MINI V4.0 (any other version of WeMos that shares the output pins should work)
A4988 stepper motor driver+heat sink (It is quite easy to burn it, especially if you are a beginner, better 2 units)
2K ohms resistors for R1 if firmware version >=1.4
